headline: Berm and Expanse Lead as Stonecradle Stirs Again
war_summary: Since the 03:16 edition the wire has quickened again at Palantine Berm and the Weathered Expanse, both filing to the 06:11 cutoff. Palantine counts nine changes in the last two hours and forty-eight on the day around The Droll, The Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni, with holdings now five Warden, one Colonial and one unheld. The Expanse counts seven changes in two hours and fifty-six on the day around Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Shattered Advance, now four Warden, two Colonial and three unheld, with twenty-four-hour losses of 8,499 Colonial and 12,253 Warden. Callahan's Passage remains hot with three changes in two hours to 05:16 and thirty-nine on the day around Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage, all ten holdings Warden-held. Stonecradle has reawakened with three changes in two hours to 05:56 and eight on the day around The Reach, while Stlican Shelf adds two changes to 04:34 and twenty-five on the day around Briar and Breaker Town. Callums Cape and the Nevish Line have gone quiet in the last hours, with Kuura Strand also still for the past two hours.
